name: Utter Disappointment
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [fear, mind-affecting]; Level bard 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target one creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The next time the subject of this spell attempts an action that requires a die roll to determine the outcome, that action fails unless they succeed at a Will save. However, the spell creates the image in the subject’s mind that it succeeded. The subject behaves accordingly for 1 round. At the end of that round the image fades from the target’s mind and they must make an additional Will save, failure means they take a -4 penalty on their next attack roll, saving throw, or skill check that occurs within 10 minutes.
